CREATE FUNCTION fn_feed_for_player( p_player_id uuid, p_limit int DEFAULT 20, p_offset int DEFAULT 0, p_types text[] DEFAULT NULL, p_since timestamptz DEFAULT NULL, p_scope text DEFAULT 'community' ) RETURNS TABLE ( id uuid, actor_player_id uuid, actor_club_id uuid, activity_type varchar(50), reference_type varchar(50), reference_id uuid, visibility varchar(20), metadata jsonb, created_at timestamptz, geo_score int, feed_reason text, feed_reason_name text ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH me AS ( SELECT pp.id FROM player_profiles pp WHERE pp.user_id = auth.uid() ), effective AS ( SELECT (SELECT m.id FROM me m) AS player_id, CASE WHEN (SELECT m.id FROM me m) IS NULL THEN 'geo' ELSE 'community' END AS scope ), my_matches AS ( SELECT mp.match_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN me ON me.id = mp.player_id ), labelled AS ( SELECT me.id AS player_id, 'self' AS reason, 1 AS prio FROM me UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN p.player1_id = me.id THEN p.player2_id ELSE p.player1_id END, 'partner', 2 FROM partnerships p JOIN me ON me.id IN (p.player1_id, p.player2_id) UNION ALL -- 076: Changed from team_ups to player_relationships follow model SELECT pr.to_player_id, 'follow', 3 FROM player_relationships pr JOIN me ON me.id = pr.from_player_id WHERE pr.relationship_type = 'follow' AND pr.status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT mp.player_id, 'opponent', 4 FROM match_participants mp JOIN my_matches mm ON mm.match_id = mp.match_id JOIN matches m ON m.id = mp.match_id WHERE m.status = 'verified' ), community AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.player_id) l.player_id, l.reason FROM labelled l WHERE l.player_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT e.scope FROM effective e) = 'community' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_relationships b, me WHERE b.relationship_type = 'block' AND b.status = 'active' AND ( (b.from_player_id = me.id AND b.to_player_id = l.player_id) OR (b.from_player_id = l.player_id AND b.to_player_id = me.id) ) ) ORDER BY l.player_id, l.prio ), my_clubs AS ( SELECT cm.club_id, c.name FROM club_memberships cm JOIN clubs c ON c.id = cm.club_id WHERE (SELECT e.scope FROM effective e) = 'community' AND cm.player_id = (SELECT e.player_id FROM effective e) AND cm.status = 'active' ), scored AS ( SELECT a.id, a.actor_player_id, a.actor_club_id, a.activity_type, a.reference_type, a.reference_id, a.visibility, a.metadata, a.created_at, COALESCE( CASE WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.barangay, c.barangay))) = lower(btrim(v.barangay)) AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.city, c.city))) = lower(btrim(v.city)) THEN 3 WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.city, c.city))) = lower(btrim(v.city)) AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.province, c.province))) = lower(btrim(v.province)) THEN 2 WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.province, c.province))) = lower(btrim(v.province)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0 ) AS geo_score, CASE WHEN c.verification_status = 'verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS verified_score, CASE WHEN mc.club_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'club' ELSE cp.reason END AS feed_reason, CASE WHEN mc.club_id IS NOT NULL THEN mc.name ELSE NULL END AS feed_reason_name FROM activities a LEFT JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = a.actor_player_id LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = a.actor_club_id LEFT JOIN player_profiles v ON v.id = (SELECT e.player_id FROM effective e) LEFT JOIN community cp ON cp.player_id = a.actor_player_id LEFT JOIN my_clubs mc ON mc.club_id = a.actor_club_id WHERE a.visibility = 'public' AND (p_types IS NULL OR a.activity_type = ANY(p_types)) AND (p_since IS NULL OR a.created_at > p_since) AND ( (SELECT e.scope FROM effective e) <> 'community' OR cp.player_id IS NOT NULL OR mc.club_id IS NOT NULL ) ) SELECT s.id, s.actor_player_id, s.actor_club_id, s.activity_type, s.reference_type, s.reference_id, s.visibility, s.metadata, s.created_at, s.geo_score, s.feed_reason, s.feed_reason_name FROM scored s ORDER BY (s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date DESC, s.geo_score DESC, s.verified_score DESC, s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset; $$;
